questions.q: A cell contains the expression price * qty * 0.92. What is the best improvement?
options: Replace 0.92 with a named constant such as LOYALTY_DISCOUNT and add a comment explaining why
Delete the comment so the code is shorter
Round 0.92 to 1 so it is easier to read
Move the expression into a different cell without changing it
questions.explain: A named constant with a short comment turns a magic number into self-documenting code and gives you one place to change it.

questions.q: Why does add_order_total start with out = df.copy()?
options: Copying makes pandas run faster
So the function never modifies the caller's DataFrame and avoids SettingWithCopyWarning
Because pandas functions cannot return a DataFrame otherwise
So that the docstring is attached to the data
questions.explain: Working on a copy means the function has no hidden side effects on the original data, and it avoids assigning into a slice of another DataFrame.

questions.q: What is the main reason to choose Kernel > Restart & Run All before sharing a notebook?
options: It makes the notebook file smaller
It automatically fixes bugs in the code
It proves the notebook works from scratch, in order, without relying on variables left in kernel memory
It is required before a notebook can be saved
questions.explain: The kernel remembers variables even after you delete the code that created them. A clean restart exposes any hidden dependence on that state.

questions.q: Which comment is most useful in a notebook?
options: # multiply quantity by price
# loop through rows
# 8% off for loyalty members
# the next line calculates a total
questions.explain: Good comments explain why, which the code cannot say by itself. Comments that restate what the code does add noise.

questions.q: You have pasted the same five lines of cleaning code into three cells. What should you do?
options: Leave it, because notebooks are for quick experiments only
Turn the repeated lines into one small function with a clear name and docstring
Delete two of the cells and hope the results stay the same
Add a comment above each copy
questions.explain: Repeated logic belongs in a function: one place to fix bugs, one name that says what it does.
